prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA perfectly captures the downward trend (corr=1.0) while FT_rf best models seasonality (corr=0.571), but they differ significantly in overall RMSE. The high rmse_spread_ratio (1.07) and unstable rankings (Kendall=-0.29) indicate strong model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to combine trend and seasonality specialists separately. Early horizon specialist ONLY_DWT_rf (185.7 RMSE) differs from late specialist ONLY_FT_catboost (161.0 RMSE), confirming per-horizon or decomposition-based weighting is valuable.
